_meta.title: ASHEN REALM — Metin2 reference catalog
_meta.scope: Reference catalog and implementation planning for a Metin2-inspired browser MMORPG.
_meta.accuracy: Starter and early-map monster catalog expanded using individual official wiki pages. Item lists reflect wiki-listed drops only; no probability is implied. Conflicting EXP values are explicitly flagged rather than guessed.
_meta.dropPolicy: Do not fabricate exact drop chances or per-monster item sources. Fill those only from a cited item page or version-matched mob_drop_item/common_drop_item/special_item_group data.

notes: Book names were expanded against the official category listing of 75 pages; many records only have category-list confirmation, not detailed effects/drop sources.
Upgrade item names were expanded from the official Upgrade Items table. The current page includes both upgrade materials and a separate craft-items table; some entries appear in both.
Do not use category-list-only entries to generate gameplay drops or recipes until their individual item pages and version are verified.
Per-monster drop tables remain empty pending source-level verification.

officialBooksIndex is the exact 75-name index from the wiki category page. books contains additional selected entries and is not expected to equal 75; reconcile individual item pages before treating it as a canonical full list.
The wiki Books table also includes Young Pet Book; included as a book-system entry even though the category listing extraction returned 74 names.
Starter monster EXP was checked against individual pages; Alpha Wolf corrected from 51 to 41 EXP.
Monster dropItems list items shown under Other Drops on individual wiki pages; exact probability is not provided and remains null. Item type labels are descriptive, not claims about drop mechanics.
Added individual-page records for Blue Wolf, Grey Wolf, Cursed Wolf, Cursed Blue Wolf, Cursed Alpha Wolf, Cursed Alpha Blue Wolf and Alpha Blue Wolf.
Alpha Wolf EXP is null with conflicting source notes: individual page reports 41, Monster overview reports 51. Resolve against intended official server/version before using EXP in gameplay.
An empty dropItems array only means the individual page lists no items in the captured drop section; it does not imply no Yang or no shared/alternative drops.

upgradeRules.rule: Equipable items are commonly upgraded to +9; some systems allow higher values. Upgrade attempts usually require Yang and upgrade materials.
NPC upgrades can destroy an item on failure depending on the upgrade method; refinement items can offer different failure outcomes.
Craft/refinement materials and upgrade materials are related but not identical categories; some items can be used in both.
Spirit stones provide persistent equipment bonuses when successfully inserted into supported equipment; insertion can fail and leave a broken slot.

knownRules.rule: Knihy majú časový odstup medzi čítaniami; oficiálna wiki uvádza približne 18 až 30 hodín a predmet Exorcism Scroll môže cooldown preskočiť.
Duchovné kamene dávajú bonus po vložení do podporovanej výbavy; vloženie môže zlyhať a poškodiť slot.
Truhlice môžu obsahovať Yang, skúsenosti, bežné alebo vzácne predmety, prípadne príšery; časť vyžaduje kľúč.

Podľa oficiálnej wiki hráč, ktorý je o 16 alebo viac úrovní vyššie než príšera, nezískava z nej EXP ani predmety; pred implementáciou treba potvrdiť, že táto verzia pravidla zodpovedá cieľovej verzii hry.
Joan, Pyungmoo a Yongan sú tri kráľovské varianty Mapy 1; rovnaké základné príšery sa vyskytujú vo všetkých troch.
